name: VoC → CTx Tree
description: Translate Voice of Customer into measurable CTx requirements
whenToUse: When customer statements should be translated into a chain of requirements — the voice of the customer, the need behind it, the measurable driver (CTQ, CTD, CTC) and the testable requirement with a target value and a measure; not for collecting or rating customer statements themselves, that is what the survey and Kano tools are for.
noVocs: No VoC statements yet. Start with the button above.
vocPlaceholder: e.g. I don't want to wait more than 2 days for my delivery.
reqPlaceholder: e.g. Delivery time ≤ 48h in 95% of cases
colorVocTip: Voice of Customer – Original customer statement about expectations, needs, or pain points
colorCtqTip: Critical to Quality – Quality characteristic that is decisive for the customer
colorCtdTip: Critical to Delivery – Delivery characteristic that is decisive for the customer
colorCtcTip: Critical to Cost – Cost characteristic that is decisive for the customer

invariants.uniqueIds: Every node in the tree – statement, need, driver and requirement – has its own non-empty id.
invariants.validColors: Every node colour is a colour as rgb(r,g,b) or rgba(r,g,b,a) with channels from 0 to 255 and an opacity from 0 to 1.
invariants.borderWidthStep: The border width lies between 0 and 4 pixels in steps of 0.5.
invariants.knownActiveVoc: Only an existing statement can be shown.
